summary: Diff adds shared LoadingState/ErrorState components and a PageLayout wrapper, and applies them to several screens/components (AuthGate, some pages, chat, match history) along with some spacing/layout tweaks. Error/loading standardization and spacing consistency appear partially applied, but not comprehensively across all pages/components shown. There are also unrelated UI/branding and hook behavior changes that were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for loading states and apply it consistently across the app screens, replacing ad-hoc loading UI.
missing_requirements.reason: Shared loading components were created and used in AuthGate and some screens/components, but the diff does not show loading-state standardization applied everywhere (e.g., some pages/components shown don’t handle loading with the shared pattern, and LeaderboardPage changes are truncated so full coverage cannot be confirmed).

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for error states (with optional retry) and apply it consistently across app screens and key data components.
missing_requirements.reason: A shared ErrorState exists and is used in ChatPanel and ProfileMatchHistory, but other key pages/components shown do not display errors via the shared pattern (e.g., DayDetailPage and AdminPage excerpts show loading/permission flows but no ErrorState usage; LeaderboardPage excerpt does not show shared error UI usage). Therefore, consistent app-wide adoption is not demonstrated in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Perform an app-wide UI spacing and consistency pass across all pages and common layouts (consistent page wrapper, headers, section spacing, card padding, button alignment).
missing_requirements.reason: PageLayout/PageHeader were introduced and applied to several pages, but the diff does not demonstrate an app-wide pass across all pages/common layouts (only some pages are shown updated; other modified layout elements are referenced only indirectly). Full uniformity across the entire app cannot be confirmed from the provided diffs.

hallucinated_features.description: Branding/visual redesign work on the login screen (background image, 'Somers Scheduler' branding, AppLogo/backdrop blur) beyond loading/error standardization and spacing polish.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists branding rework as a non-goal; these changes appear unrelated to standardizing loading/error UI and spacing consistency.

hallucinated_features.description: New/changed PWA install UX in TopBar (conditional Install button, instructions dialog).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goals include reworking PWA behavior beyond what is necessary to standardize loading/error presentation; adding install prompt UI is outside the requested scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Behavior change in a query hook: useGetAllUserProfiles queryFn returns an empty Map regardless of actor (appears to stub out functionality).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested (request is UI polish/consistency), and risks functional regression contrary to REQ-3 acceptance criteria.
